name: MA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Auchincloss's large financial advantage ($7.3M cash vs. $1.3K)
Incumbency in a deep-blue Massachusetts seat
model.rationale: The fundamentals point firmly to Auchincloss: a D+11 district, incumbency, and a massive fundraising edge over a Republican challenger who has raised only about $26,000. Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 97%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly strong Republican fundraising surge would be the main things to move this race, though neither is evident.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jake Auchincloss seeks a fourth term in a Massachusetts district that leans Democratic by about 11 points on the partisan baseline. He enters the general election with a dominant financial position, having raised $3.6 million and holding $7.3 million on hand, while Republican Thomas Stalcup has raised roughly $26,000 with almost no cash remaining. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent.

No public general-election polls cover the race, and no expert raters have weighed in, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing. Polymarket puts the Democratic win probability near 97%. With the incumbent well-funded and the challenger barely resourced, the seat is rated Safe Democratic.
